name: Abstract Tales: Techno-World
storyline:
"Let's keep running! If we stop, we won't get our families back!"

It was just another day when the gang found CHARMA discs, which when brought close to a person fuse with them, allowing them to unleash their CHARMA power.

But these discs are secret technology created by the Project Involving Foundation, who create technology that no one should know about.

When the P.I.F. noticed that the gang got the discs, they kidnapped their parents, so now they must learn to use their new powers and travel to Techno-World to save them before it's too late!
summary: Abstract Tales: Techno-World is a beat 'em up with cute cartoony characters and some action! Join Adrian, Elliott, Cindy, Canaan, and Clover and help them to reach Techno-World and save their parents before it's too late! Play with 5 different characters, use different special moves, go through 11 stages, and unleash your power!
